facts.fact: The Pôle national de lutte contre la cybercriminalité sentenced journalist Chahana Takiou, founder-director of the newspaper 22 septembre, to 12 months in prison with 6 suspended on 3 August 2026, for undermining the credit of the State through the judicial institution, after he was summoned by the Pôle and held on remand.
